title: Drowning a Dinosaur
content: I know: the photographic evidence seems to implicate me. It looks like I’m drowning a dinosaur.But really I just want to know what an ceratopsian would look like in shoulder-deep water.It was just one of many references I used to create this scene fromDinotopia: Journey to Chandara.The book is availablesigned from meor fromAmazon.com.
